model_rule: .converge/playbooks/ is source blueprint; .converge/journal/ is executable run state/evidence. Fix source or loader/compiler behavior; do not hand-edit manifest.json or runstate.json.
commands_run: grep -rn "manifest.json|runstate.json|.converge/playbooks|.converge/journal" packages/core/src/ packages/cli/src/ | grep -v node_modules | head -40
grep -rn "single source of truth" packages/core/src/ | grep -v node_modules

findings.gap: syncPlaybookToJournal() mirrors playbook source files into .converge/journal/ and declares the journal is the single source of truth for both task definitions and runtime state, contradicting the Blueprint vs Runtime model which assigns playbooks/ as the exclusive design-time blueprint.
findings.evidence: sync.ts lines 215-217: the journal can serve as the single source of truth for task definitions AND runtime state. sync.ts lines 219-232: syncPlaybookToJournal() copies playbook.yml and .playbook-hash into the shared journal directory.
findings.correction: Restrict syncPlaybookToJournal() to only copy task snapshots into execution-scoped directories. Remove the mirroring of playbook source files into the shared journal root. Move .playbook-hash to .converge/cache/. The journal must remain strictly runtime artifacts.
findings.test_to_write: tests/playbook-journal-boundary.test.ts - verifies that no playbook source files exist in the shared journal directory after sync; only execution-scoped task snapshots are present.

findings.gap: ingestSpawnedChildrenFromRunstate() reads runstate.json from .converge/journal/{playbook}/executions/{entry}/runstate.json, but RunStateManager persists it to .converge/journal/{playbook}/runstate.json (without executions/). The tree-based navigator silently fails to discover spawned children from the DAG runner.
findings.evidence: dag-tree.ts line 335: journalRoot = join(projectDir, .converge, journal, playbookName, executions) vs run-state-manager.ts line 48: this.statePath = join(executionDir, runstate.json) where executionDir = targetDir = join(projectDir, .converge, journal, playbookName)
findings.correction: Align ingestSpawnedChildrenFromRunstate() to read runstate.json from the same path used by RunStateManager: .converge/journal/{playbook}/runstate.json. Remove the executions/ subdirectory indirection.
findings.test_to_write: tests/runstate-ingest-consistency.test.ts - spawn a child via RunStateManager, then verify ingestSpawnedChildrenFromRunstate() can discover it.

findings.gap: Docstring describes layout as target/{playbook}/manifest.json but no target/ directory exists - compiled artifacts are written to .converge/journal/{playbook}/. The documentation does not match the filesystem reality.
findings.evidence: structure.ts lines 7-16: comment documents target/{playbook}/ directory structure; structure.ts line 82: implementation returns join(projectDir, .converge, journal, name)
findings.correction: Update the docstring to reflect the actual layout: .converge/journal/{playbook}/manifest.json. The single-target model uses .converge/journal/ as the target directory; document it accurately.
